text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Attention, everyone! Regarding the results of this round—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Carrying out the construction plan and recruiting testers! Followed by countless days spent polishing everything up!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Especially you, Ryan! Gathering the testers all started because of you! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all!
It's all thanks to everyone's hard work.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Naturally, you all worked hard too!
And so—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's a party!
I'll feed you so much coconut your stomach'll burst!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! Tucker-san's custom
coconut juice is the absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
These shells, and these greens... I've never seen them before,
but they're all so delicious...! It's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Dahaha! Well, yeah, it's one of my few special skills!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
However, I'll be busy come summer.
I won't be able to make it for a while, so savor it now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right!
Summer training camp is always super busy, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "At this rate, it looks like plenty of Umamusume and Trainers will be using Tracen Island, so we have to do our best too...!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The more feedback we get, the better Tracen Island will become.
We shall draw ever closer to being the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Get plenty of training in, you guys,
and send in your reports!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 3rd Tracen Island Evaluation ended...
and the next construction plan began!
